prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair THIS SIX-FACE CUBEMAP ATLAS, preserving the exact 1536x1024 pixel size, 3-column x 2-row square grid and face order. It currently fails inside-cube projection: planetary horizons form V-shaped corners at face joins. Fix the GEOMETRY of the horizon in the FOUR SIDE FACES, not just the style. Face order top row RIGHT +X, LEFT -X, FRONT +Y; bottom row BACK -Y, UP +Z, DOWN -Z. EACH side face is a 90x90 degree RECTILINEAR perspective view. Physical horizon at latitude -10 degrees requires face-local horizon y(x)=0.5 + 0.0881635 * sqrt(1+(2*x-1)^2), where x,y are normalized 0..1. Therefore the horizon in EACH of the FOUR side squares MUST pass through these normalized coordinates: (0,.6247),(.25,.5986),(.5,.5882),(.75,.5986),(1,.6247). For 512px faces: at x=0 and512 horizon y=320; at x128 and384 horizon y=306; at x256 horizon y=301. This shallow curve dips toward the left/right edges in the flat image; the cubemap renderer straightens it into the correct continuous spherical limb. Do NOT place horizon at middle or above middle. This is the essential correction. Preserve the beautiful fictional planet, oceans, clouds and atmosphere, but align coastline/cloud details at proper physical neighboring edges: FRONT right joins RIGHT left; RIGHT right joins BACK left; BACK right joins LEFT left; LEFT right joins FRONT left. Same small sun only once in FRONT. UP face stays pure black starry space, DOWN stays only detailed ocean/land/clouds with no horizon or sky. Ensure cloud patterns at DOWN's edges connect to bottom edges of the side faces with appropriate rotations. No text, labels, gutters or border. Photoreal premium game skybox art, crisp detail. Output one corrected atlas.
status: Visual inspection required. Projection constraints in a prompt are not proof of mathematical compliance.
